question: 플래티넘 구간에서 아드리아나의 최신 패치 승률은?
sql: SELECT COUNT(p.participant_id) AS samples, ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE p.game_rank = 1) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS win_rate FROM participants p WHERE p.version_major = 5 AND p.version_minor = 0 AND p.tier = '플래티넘' AND p.character_num = 17 GROUP BY p.character_num LIMIT 200
